## 4. Architecture and pipeline

```
  CI / IDE / dev ──► SonarScanner ──► POST analyze ──► Web ──► queue in DB
                                                        │
                             DB (Postgres/Oracle/MSSQL) ◄┤ CE ( Compute Engine )
                                     ▲                   │
                                     └── index ─────────► ES (Elasticsearch)
```

Four Java processes: **`Sonar`** (app, supervisor), **`Web`** (UI + Web API), **`CE`**
(reports), **`Elasticsearch`** (indexed DB copy). The DB holds configuration,
metrics/issues and the report queue; Web and CE keep DB and ES consistent; on index
disaster recovery **Web** rebuilds it (source:
`https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-community-build/server-installation/server-components-overview.md`).
Logs: `sonar.log`, `web.log`, `ce.log`, `es.log`, `access.log`, `deprecation.log`
(`sonar-application/src/main/assembly/conf/sonar.properties:344-355`).

1. **Full checkout** in CI; a shallow clone makes SCM skip blame and can fail analysis
   (`https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-community-build/analyzing-source-code/overview.md`).
2. **Build + dedicated scanner** (Maven/Gradle/.NET/NPM/Python) or CLI as fallback, with
   `sonar.*` parameters in `sonar-project.properties`, CLI, env vars or UI; the **server
   queues the report**, **CE** writes metrics/issues to DB + ES, **Web** serves UI/API and
   the **Quality Gate**, which CI polls to fail the pipeline - see `01`, `08`, `12`, `14`.

## 5. Configuration in three layers

| Layer | Where | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| Server | `conf/sonar.properties`, env vars, `api/settings` | **full** restart; `api/system/restart` does not reload (`sonar.properties:1-6`) |
| Project | `sonar-project.properties`, `-Dsonar.*`, UI | key `sonar.<prop>`; secrets via `SONAR_TOKEN` |
| Code | plugin/rules/profile | via Web API or UI, persisted in DB |

Env overrides: uppercase, `.` and `-` to `_` (`sonar.web.systemPasscode` ->
`SONAR_WEB_SYSTEMPASSCODE`) (`sonar.properties:8-12`).

## 7. Golden rules

- Edition first: never prescribe a Server/Cloud feature for Community Build.
- DB is truth; ES is a derived index rebuildable by Web; H2 for tests only
  (`sonar.properties:17-20`).
- Quality Gate acts on **new code**; Sonar way has 4 conditions and a 20-line fudge factor
  (`.../introduction-to-quality-gates.md`).
- Dedicated scanner per build; CLI only as fallback; full clone in CI (`fetch-depth: 0`).
- Web API: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; `X-Sonar-Passcode` only when bearer does not fit.
- ES on loopback; ports 9000 (web), 9001 (search) never public
  (`sonar.properties:97-110,298-309`); check EOL/LTA before upgrading
  (`gradle.properties:3-11`).

# 02 — Architecture and processes

## 1. JVM processes

[CB] docs declare three Java processes plus the **`Sonar`** (App) process managing their
availability (source: https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-community-build/server-installation/server-components-overview.md).
The four identifiers appear in the log format: `app`, `web`, `ce`, `es` (source:
`sonar-application/src/main/assembly/conf/sonar.properties:344-395`).

| Process | Responsibility | Verified port/default | Log |
|---|---|---|---|
| App (`app`) | manages availability of the others | - | `sonar.log` (`sonar.properties:347-352`) |
| Web (`web`) | serves the UI and the Web API | HTTP **9000** (`sonar.properties:109-110`); 50 threads, min 5, queue 25 (`:113-125`) | `web.log` |
| CE (`ce`) | processes analysis reports, writes to the DB | no HTTP port of its own | `ce.log` |
| Search/ES (`es`) | mirror index of the DB for search | HTTP **9001** (`sonar.properties:298-300`); TCP transport on loopback, random port (`:302-304`) | `es.log` |

Heap: values are *placeholders* resolved at build time - `@webDefaultHeapSize@` (source:
`sonar.properties:78-92`), `@ceDefaultHeapSize@` (`:259-269`), `@searchDefaultHeapSize@`
with `MaxDirectMemorySize` = half the heap (`:275-296`). `sonar.search.host` defaults to loopback, never expose it

blocks ES cluster startup (source: `sonar.properties:281-289`).

`sonar-application` holds the `main`: `App.main` calls `App.start` (source:

| `server:sonar-webserver-es` (`:56`) | index: `IndexDefinitions`, `IssueIndex`, `ComponentIndex`, `ProjectMeasuresIndex`, `RecoveryIndexer` |
| `server:sonar-ce` (`:38`) | queue and workers (`InternalCeQueueImpl`, `CeProcessingSchedulerImpl`, `CeWorkerImpl`) |
| `server:sonar-ce-task-projectanalysis` (`:41`) | project analysis/export task processors |
| `server:sonar-db-dao` (`:42`) | data access |
| `server:sonar-db-migration` (`:43`) | versioned schema migrations |
| `sonar-application` (`:65`) | distribution (assembly, scripts, `conf/sonar.properties`) |

Hazelcast code exists in `server/sonar-process/src/main/java/org/sonar/process/cluster/hz/`
